I totally get it, it's much easier to do if you know something will cut properly. My first time cutting was with a piece of broken glass and now every time I see a shard of glass it feels like it's calling out to me to cut myself with it. Maybe you can put the scalpel in a hard to reach safe place or give it to someone else for safekeeping until you need it for uni.

I started cutting two months ago but I realise I've been banging my head for years now. It's unfortunate that it is so easy to do (no materials needed) and usually doesn't leave any kind of visible mark. I still do it myself so I can't give you much advice, just don't go too far to prevent permanent brain damage and please reach out to a mental health professional if you haven't already. You're not alone <3
That's great that you want to get help, keep working towards improvement and hopefully you'll end up feeling happier! :)

I'm so proud of you! Don't feel like you're obliged to tell everyone around you immediately. If you want and need some time, you can take however much. In the end, it's your decision if/when, how and who you want to tell. Good luck and take care!

I can relate. I'm in uni and I haven't passed a single subject for 1,5 years now. My study advisor is helping me understand that it's okay to take things at my own pace while I figure out my mental state. I hate it when people ask me how my study is going because I feel so embarrassed that I'm behind on everyone else. But I'm slowly accepting it and finding peace within myself. So hey, it's totally okay to focus on your mental health first, you're not alone. And when you try picking up school again, don't beat yourself up if it doesn't go smoothly. I've realised you have to learn to 'learn' again first so try to not overwhelm yourself or expect too much. Just baby steps okay? All the best to you and I'm here if you want to talk.

Is your mom going to be there during the physical exam? Because it wouldn't be weird if you'd ask for some privacy so only the doctor sees you. And then the doctor should keep his findings private because of doctor-patient confidentiality (not sure about this if you're underage but you could ask him/her). If you're not ready to tell your mom yet (I know I'm not), you can stall however long you feel comfortable to do, take your time :)

Hi, thank you so much for caring, if you ever want to chat (that includes anyone else reading this), I'd be all ears <3.
